items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 2:1
items.html: Avir [air] means: light of Ruach, namely light of Hassadim, as is known. And Avira Dachya [pure air] means: light of Hassadim of the GAR of Bina, which, even though it is Hassadim, is nevertheless considered a complete GAR, like the light of Hochma. And plain Avir means: VAK without GAR, meaning that they already need the illumination of Hochma, since they are of the aspect of the ZAT of Bina or of ZA, and without this they are considered a body without a head. (Item 126).
